items.description: Tenant must prepare and deliver to Landlord a mutually acceptable press release announcing Tenant's occupancy of the Premises.
items.span_text: After both parties have signed this Lease Tenant shall prepare and deliver to Landlord a mutually acceptable press release (“Initial Press Release”) announcing Tenant’s occupancy of the Premises in the Building, which Landlord shall have the right to publish and disseminate.
items.trigger: After both parties have signed this Lease

items.description: Landlord may post other press releases about the lease only without disclosing location, economics or square footage, and subject to Tenant's prior written approval.
items.span_text: provided that same does not disclose the location, economics or square footage related hereto, except that each such other press release shall be subject to Tenant’s review and prior written approval, which Tenant may grant or withhold in its sole discretion.
